result.summary: Found 2 minor issues related to text contrast and content redundancy.

issues.description: Secondary information like delivery fees and time estimates exhibits low color contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Increase the font weight or use a darker shade of gray for secondary text to improve legibility.

issues.description: The delivery fee is displayed twice on featured restaurant cards, appearing in both an overlay badge and the info line.
issues.suggestion: Remove the redundant text from the info line to reduce visual clutter on the card.
